experiment: N2 unused indoor GT acquisition and split registration
unused_evidence: docs/experiments/E4c_surface_consistency_pruning_results.md: office2/office3 RGB, GT and baseline were not opened
N0/N1 local asset inventory contains only office0, office1, room0, room1, room2
office4 has no prior local scene data, baseline or download manifest
selection_rule: Use the three remaining rendered Replica scene IDs in numeric order; register roles before downloading or decoding them; no quality-based scene replacement.
model_input: even original frame IDs in [0,1000), RGB only (500 frames)

calibration.alignment_pose_ids: even original frame IDs in [0,200), 100 matched poses
calibration.prefix_reason: Fixed first 20 percent of the 1000-frame run; longer than the short N1 pilot; independent of predictions/oracle effects.
calibration.global_gauge: one Sim(3) fit on calibration positions, fixed for every arm and later frame
calibration.local_units: C = fitted global scale * first KF raw scale; one fixed C for all KFs

evaluation.heldout_rgb_depth_pose_ids: odd original frame IDs in [200,1000), 400 frames
evaluation.source_candidate_scope: self-branch KFs anchored on even original frame IDs >=200; prefix KFs are context only for primary local-effect analysis
evaluation.full_map_sensitivity: may include prefix KFs; report separately from post-prefix strict-candidate analysis
evaluation.unused_prefix_odd_rgb: odd original IDs <200 are excluded from primary evaluation and model input

camera_contract.pose_definition: traj.txt row-major camera-to-world 4x4 matrices, metric translation
camera_contract.timestamp_definition: original frame ordinal; no sensor rate or seconds are assumed
camera_contract.resize_crop_intrinsics: N1/E0 convention: 512x290 then top=1,left=0 crop to 512x288; K scales without extra half-pixel offset

surface_reference: Inspect archive catalogue for a supplied mesh. If absent, use observed GT-depth samples/TSDF as an observation-limited reference; do not claim full-scene mesh completeness.
final_test_policy: office4 receives only predetermined integrity/format/pose/depth validity and algebraic self-projection QA. No visual inspection, cross-view residual analysis, model inference, oracle metrics or parameter tuning. Release only after the final algorithm/evaluation protocol is frozen; if consumed earlier it must be relabelled and cannot remain the sealed final test.
failure_policy: Report failed data/QA gates; do not change scene roles, frame intervals or thresholds in response to prediction quality. Any technical amendment must be explicit and preserve prior records.
scope: N2 data readiness only. No tracking/KF count, GPU feasibility on these scenes, A0 effect or method efficacy has been measured. All three scenes share the Replica synthetic indoor domain.
